title: Restriction of a Walsh character
statement: Let $V$ be a vector space over $ br/	ext{?}$—more precisely, over the field with two elements—and let $H$ be a subspace of $V$. For every linear functional $\psi:V\to\mathbb{F}_2$ and every $h\in H$, the Walsh character on $H$ obtained by restricting $\psi$ takes at $h$ the same value as the Walsh character on $V$ takes at the image of $h$ in $V$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and an $\mathbb{F}_2$-module
